description.zh:
根据应用过滤告警历史json格式 包含字段如下：

datasource_type	STRING	否	["CUSTOM","STACK","TABLE]		
是应用监控，还是自定义监控

datasource	STRING	否	MM@@2000464		
数据源

alarm_target_type	STRING	否	["APP","HOST"]		
应用类型

alarm_target_identify	STRING	否	RMS-monitorprod		
应用名称
description.en:
A JSON-formatted string for filtering alert history by application. It contains the following fields:

datasource_type	STRING	No	["CUSTOM","STACK","TABLE"]		
Indicates whether it is application monitoring or custom monitoring.

datasource	STRING	No	MM@@2000464		
Data source

alarm_target_type	STRING	No	["APP","HOST"]		
Application type

alarm_target_identify	STRING	No	RMS-monitorprod		
Application name

description.zh:
查询数据的终止日期，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

> 查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，最晚只能查询到当天凌晨0点的数据。
description.en:
The end date of the query data, in Unix timestamp format, in milliseconds.

> The query end time must be later than the query start time. The latest data you can query is up to 00:00 (midnight) of the current day.

description.zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

> 查询开始时间需在数据库实例SQL洞察存储时长范围内，最大不能早于当前时间90天。
description.en:
Query start time, in Unix timestamp format, in milliseconds.  

> The query start time must fall within the SQL Explorer storage duration of the database instance and cannot be earlier than 90 days before the current time.
